target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (§5 Processes: a quality under another name)

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (§5 Processes: a quality under another name)

fix: Slots: bearer leaf margin PO:0020128, attribute width, low/high 1-2, unit 'cell' (cells across the width), with the cue. RDF only, like pattern 14 (no class), because a width in cells is neither a length nor a count of the margin's parts.

fix: Split 'whitish,hyaline' at the comma (there is no space after it) into two statements: white with value_qualifier approximately (pattern 01), and transparent PATO:0000964 (PATO synonym 'hyaline').
reason: There is no alternative or continuum here. The missing space after the comma made the two words look like one.

fix: Read 'N–M-ternate' as one_of the existing values: biternate FLOPO:0991241 or triternate FLOPO:0991362. The bearer is the leaf (these values are defined for a compound leaf), not the leaf blade.
reason: Both values already exist. The numeric prefix range only needs a table row, not a count.

fix: Bearer: involucral bract PO:0009045, not 'bract'. Shape: the continuum linear PATO:0001199 – filiform PATO:0104351. Also a count of 3–6 with container involucre PO:0009100.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (§5 Processes: a quality under another name)

fix: 'enclosing' is surrounding PATO:0001772 (in the table), towards nut fruit PO:0030102 (PO synonym 'nut'). Keep 'ca. 3/4' as a fraction in RDF only.

fix: 'several' after the noun is the amount 'several': bracteole PO:0009043 present, count_word several. Container: the partial umbel (involucel).
